verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business plans document sharing one business number with a team (docs-20), adding users and managing numbers (docs-18), simultaneous or rollover ringing (docs-16), live transfer, and texting customers from the dashboard or app (docs-17). That covers only the shared-number part of the story; nothing documents agent presence, assigning conversations to teammates, or internal notes or threads. Missing for 10: presence/availability status, conversation assignment, internal threads or notes on conversations, independent corroboration.
